title: Use one clear title pattern, under 60 characters, on every zedu.chat page, by Fri 20 Nov
description:
Checked on 22 Oct 2026: titles are 'Home', 'Pricing | Zedu', 'About | Zedu', 'Contact Sales | Zedu', but 'Zedu - Seamless Video Meetings & Learning Communities' on solutions and 'Zedu - Learning Platform for Bootcamps, Schools, and Cohorts' on resources, and the download page title is longer than 60 characters. Home is just 'Home' (a separate goal covers the home page's share preview).

Success looks like: one pattern (for example 'Page topic | Zedu'), every public marketing page under 60 characters, and each title unique and describing its own page. Verify with curl and list each page's old and new title.

acceptedWorkstreams.title: Give the client-component pages a layout.ts so they stop inheriting the home page title
acceptedWorkstreams.description: Why /resources shows 'Zedu - Learning Platform for Bootcamps, Schools, and Cohorts': src/app/(homepage)/resources/page.tsx starts with 'use client', so it can't export metadata and inherits the (homepage) layout's title (checked 22 Oct 2026). /policy and /terms-of-service had the same problem, and the branch already fixes them with a metadata-only layout.ts; /resources needs the same. Three contributor pages (ibis, sparrow, zedu-weaver) export a title but no template-aware pattern. Plan: list every 'use client' page under (homepage), add a layout.ts with a title in the agreed pattern for each, and curl-check every title after a build.

acceptedWorkstreams.title: One title pattern applied across every marketing page, with the keyword from the map
acceptedWorkstreams.description: I measured the live titles on 22 Oct 2026 and the pattern problem is clear. The homepage title is the single word 'Home'. /about is 'About | Zedu' and /pricing is 'Pricing | Zedu', which name nothing about the product. /resources, /policy and /terms-of-service all share the identical title 'Zedu - Learning Platform for Bootcamps, Schools, and Cohorts', so three unrelated pages compete with each other and with the homepage for the same terms. The approach is one pattern, applied everywhere, with the keyword for each page taken from the education keyword map so two pages never target the same search. Deliverable: the pattern, the reason it works for both a search result and a shared link, and the rewritten title for every public marketing page with its character count, plus the list of pages whose title must change for duplicate reasons rather than keyword reasons.

acceptedWorkstreams.title: Use the title template that already exists, and stop pages overriding it
acceptedWorkstreams.description: zedu-fe's src/app/(homepage)/layout.tsx already sets title.template '%s | Zedu', which is why Pricing and About are consistent. The odd titles come from pages that set a full title or none: home ('Home'), resources and solutions (the long layout default), and download (64 characters). Tasks: (1) list every page's title source file and whether it uses the template; (2) give each page a short topic title that the template turns into 'Topic | Zedu' under 60 characters, with the home page as the one exception that leads with what Zedu is; (3) re-fetch every page and record old and new title with character counts.
